name: @xalians/api
description: Xalian generation engine and CRUD lambdas. TypeScript handlers over promise-based repositories, bundled per handler by esbuild to dist/<name>/index.mjs. @aws-sdk/* is external at bundle time because nodejs22.x provides it at runtime. src/legacy/ is the old CommonJS generation engine (allowJs), kept only to serve GET /xalian and POST /db/xalian until Wave D moves generation onto @xalians/rules.
